title: One live cloud run must confirm the deployed platform's waitForEvent timeout path
body: The catchability of a timed-out step.waitForEvent was verified against the local workerd runtime (the same engine), and the catch is what keeps a timed-out wait from failing the whole Workflow instance. Production poll cadences (15s+) always use the event wait, so if the deployed Workflows service handled that throw differently every production run would die at its first look. u9h's gate run (or the first real cloud run after this merges) should assert a `signal:done` dispatch row AND that a run completes normally on the default cadence, which settles it from both ends at once.
